verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for bookkeeping software, since self-hostable accounting ledgers exist, so the story applies to Kick. The evidence pack describes only a hosted SaaS with paid plan tiers, MCP/CLI access, Plaid bank connections and Kick-managed encryption. Nothing shows a self-hosted, on-premise or open-source deployment option; the "self-driving" phrase in the docs index refers to automation, not hosting.
